text.text: NetApp ® All Flash FAS (AFF) systems address enterprise storage requirements with high performance, superior flexibility, and best-in-class data management. Built on ONTAP ® data management software, AFF systems speed up business without compromising on the efficiency, reliability, or flexibility of IT operations. As an enterprise-grade all-flash array, AFF systems optimize I/O and maximize application throughput while running flash-optimizing functions to accelerate a broad range of SAN and NAS workloads.

text.text: NetApp AFF is not only an excellent choice for performance-demanding applications such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB databases, VDI, and server virtualization, but is also a great choice for shared environments with a variety of workloads commonly found in a data center.

text.text: Designed specifically for flash, the AFF A300 series all-flash systems deliver industry-leading performance, capacity, density, scalability, security and network connectivity in a dense form factor. All Flash FAS systems can be ordered with a factory-configured FC SAN or NAS optimized configuration, increasing simplicity and decreasing time to value and cluster creation. With up to 46.9PB of effective capacity, a max of 384 SSDs, 4 PCIe expansion slots, and 256GB of memory per HA pair the A300 is an ideal platform for a variety of workloads.

With up to 46.9PB of effective capacity, a max of 384 SSDs, 4 PCIe expansion slots, and 256GB of memory per HA pair the A300 is an ideal platform for a variety of workloads.

text.text: NetApp ONTAP 9 is the next generation of the industry’s leading data management software. It combines new levels of simplicity and flexibility with powerful data management capabilities and storage efficiencies across flash, disk and cloud. It serves as the foundation for the NetApp Data Fabric allowing customers access to their data wherever it resides. In addition to being available with all AFF systems, ONTAP is also packaged as a virtualized instance within public hyperscalers.
